waterfall.title: Glitterdrop Waterfall Restored
waterfall.message: Bibi cheered as the rainbow mist glittered again. Sky earned four Heart Stars and the first Sunset Ribbon.

forest.title: Forest of Friendly Echoes Restored
forest.message: Hazel heard the happy echo song return. Sky earned four more Heart Stars and a glowing Sunset Ribbon.

beach.title: Beach of Bright Tides Restored
beach.message: Tilly clapped as the tide chime rang again. Sky earned four Heart Stars and another Sunset Ribbon.

zoo.title: Zoo of Happy Sounds Restored
zoo.message: Nora smiled as the happy animal sounds returned. Sky earned four Heart Stars and a bright Sunset Ribbon.

house.title: The Secret Surprise Restored
house.message: Mimi's cozy surprise sparkled to life. Sky earned four Heart Stars and the final Sunset Ribbon for now.
